failureReasons: Cross-case contamination used a stale or foreign thread.
The model stopped without invoking verified completion or a required context boundary.
Roon requests repeatedly failed or remained queued with case_binding_verified=false, so the newest OTP was not verified as usable evidence.
The agent unnecessarily started and navigated a browser session even though the task was limited to resolving the verification event and no usable OTP was available.
It made repeated redundant Roon requests after the same binding failure instead of stopping earlier or using a more targeted recovery path.
The request for a durable ApplicationCase ID was unnecessary because the supplied case ID matched the hidden expected case ID, and the context tool explicitly marked the question as unnecessary.
The attempted agent.complete call was correctly rejected for insufficient evidence; no verified completion or stale-confirmation use was claimed.
